title: Student Wellbeing Foundations
description: A 16-module introductory wellbeing course based on the SpeakOut Student Wellbeing Handbook.
completionCriteria: Score 70% or higher on final quiz

modules.title: Welcome to SpeakOut
modules.subtitle: Your Wellbeing Journey Begins
reflectionQuestions: What does wellbeing mean to you?
Which area of your wellbeing needs the most attention right now?

modules.subtitle: Understanding the foundation

lessons.title: What Is Mental Health?: Core Lesson
What Is Mental Health?: Reflection Activity
What Is Mental Health?: Knowledge Check

reflectionQuestions: What mental health myths have you heard?
How can schools make it safer for students to speak up?
What is one fact about mental health you want others to know?

modules.subtitle: Self-awareness and growth
reflectionQuestions: What are three strengths you have?

modules.title: Understanding Emotions

modules.title: Managing Stress
